# The Kane Academy

> The Kane Academy is basketball parent education for families of AAU and travel basketball players, founded by Coach Dennis Kane, a retired San Diego high school basketball coach.

## Who Coach Kane is

Dennis Kane is the founder and head coach of The Kane Academy. He retired as the 6th winningest boys basketball coach in San Diego high school history, with 440 career wins across 44 years of coaching. He placed 71 players in collegiate basketball and 12 in professional basketball, and won 10 league titles, 1 CIF title, with 6 CIF finals appearances and 4 state playoff bids. He now coaches parents directly, helping them support their child's basketball development without the common mistakes that undermine it.

## What The Kane Academy offers

A four-tier product ladder for parents, from a free newsletter to full-season coaching:

1. **Newsletter** (Free) — Coach Kane's insights on AAU, recruiting, and raising a ballplayer, delivered via email opt-in. https://kanebasketballacademy.com/newsletter/
2. **The Basketball Parent IQ System** ($47) — A 14-day online system for parents, 20 minutes a night, with nightly check-ins, ten 60-second audio sessions from Coach Kane (including how to talk to your child's coach), the car ride home framework, and a bonus chapter on AAU, recruiting and NIL. https://kanebasketballacademy.com/services/playbooks/
3. **Future Success Audit** ($300) — A single 50-minute diagnostic call with Coach Kane covering any organized basketball situation (AAU, middle school, or high school), ending in three named priorities and a same-day written report. The fee credits toward the Kane Development System if the family enrolls. https://kanebasketballacademy.com/services/audits/
4. **Kane Development System** ($2,500) — The flagship program: a season of guidance across four sessions (The Plan, The System, Navigation, The Review), including a custom 12-month development plan for the child and The Basketball Parent IQ System. https://kanebasketballacademy.com/1-on-1-calls/

## Notes

The Kane Academy is a standalone digital-product business and is not affiliated with, and does not share pricing or content with, any other basketball academy site bearing Coach Kane's name.
